description: Energies - Part des énergies renouvelables dans le réseau de chaleur urbain is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Transition Écologique et du Climat - Ville de Paris. Evolution de la part globale d’énergie renouvelable dans le mix énergétique délivré par le réseau de chaleur urbain parisien, tout type d’énergie renouvelable confondu: valorisation énergétique des déchets ménagers, biomasse, géothermie, biométhane, ou encore biocombustibles. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are ENR2, Energies, DTEC, OBS-TES, Climat. The portal shows 13 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
